decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement, Location Plan, Map showing TfL owned land, Design and Access Statement,  Appendix 1: Minutes of Stakeholder Consultation Meetings, Appendix 2: Archaeological Recording of the Trial Panel Report, Appendix 3: Heritage Statement, Drawing Numbers CHB-0100-PBR-CC-DRG-0008 A, CHB-0100-PBR-CC-DRG-0007 A, CHB-0100-PBR-CC-DRG-0012 A,  CHB-0100-PBR-CC-DRG-0013 A, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0022 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0024 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0025 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0028 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0031 B, CHB-1700-PBR-DE-DRG-0103 A, CHB-1700-PBR-DE-DRG-0104 A, CHB-0400- PBR-DE-DRG-0029B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0030 B, CH-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0027 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0023 B, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0034A, CHB-0400-PBR-DE-DRG-0032 B, CHB-2000-PBR-DE-DRG-0001 B, CHB-2000-PBR-DE-DRG-0003 B, CHB-2000-PBR-DE-DRG-0002 B, CHB-1300-PBR-DRG-0001 A, CHB-1300-PBR-DE-DRG-0003 A, Structures and Tunnels Investment Portfolio, Defect report, Portland Stone Data Schedule, Schedule for the Specification of Designed Concrete, Specification for Baluster Portland Stone, Brickwork, Blockwork and Stonework Schedule, Schedule for the Specification of Designed Concrete 2, Requirements for Structural Steelwork, Jordans Whitbed Technical Data, Photos x7 received 09/12/13.   ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
